name: How can I choose the best windows for energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: How can I choose the best windows for energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: To choose energy-efficient windows, look for products with a low U-factor, which indicates how well a window prevents heat from escaping. A low Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) is important for reducing heat gain from the sun, especially in warmer climates like Orange County. Features like double or triple-pane glass, low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, and argon or krypton gas fills significantly improve insulation and overall energy performance. We can help you select options tailored to your local climate and home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for windows with low U-factor and SHGC ratings. Features like double-pane glass, Low-E coatings, and gas fills enhance energy efficiency.
